description: This file defines the PlaywrightServer class which manages WebSocket connections, browser instances, and modes of operation for the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for initializing different modes, handling connections, and managing browser lifecycle.

classes.name: PlaywrightServer
classes.description: Manages WebSocket server, browser instances, and connection modes for Playwright.

methods.name: _initReuseBrowsersMode
methods.description: Reuses existing browsers matching criteria or launches a new one.

methods.name: _initConnectMode
methods.description: Initializes a connection in 'connect' mode, possibly launching a new browser.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Uses a pre-launched browser instance for connections.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedAndroidMode
methods.description: Uses a pre-launched Android device for connections.

methods.name: _initLaunchBrowserMode
methods.description: Launches a new browser with specified options.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server listening on specified port and hostname.
